title: Sign up and verify the e-mail address
caption: PF-01, PF-02. The e-mail arrives in Mailpit locally.

steps.title: Fill the sign-up form
steps.body: Full name, e-mail address, a password of 12+ characters with a letter and a digit, tick the terms, **Create account**.
steps.expect: Redirect to `/sign-up/check-email` ("Check your e-mail"). An 11-character password is refused at the field, keeping name and address but not the password.

steps.title: Check the database
steps.body: `select status, email_verified_at, terms_version from platform.accounts where lower(email)=lower('<address>');`

steps.title: Open the link
steps.body: Open "Confirm your e-mail address for Velexis" and click the link (`/verify-email?token=…`).
steps.expect: 303 to `/sign-in?verified=1` with "Your e-mail address is verified. Sign in to continue." The URL no longer holds the token. A second click lands on `/verify-pending?error=token`.

steps.title: Same address again
steps.body: Sign up again with the same address.
steps.expect: Same "Check your e-mail" answer; the owner gets "You already have a Velexis account" instead (no second account row).

steps.title: Sign in
steps.body: Sign in with the address and password.
steps.expect: `/dashboard` ("My OTAs", "You have no OTA yet"); cookies `__Host-vxp_at` and `__Host-vxp_rt` are httpOnly and Secure.
